address: Kesa House, #01-06, ​55 Keong Saik Road, 089158, Singapore
bio: Two things catch your attention when you set foot in this long-standing household name – the small walk-in cellar and the bustling open kitchen, where chef-owner Mag can be seen working with her team. Octopus with tomato and chorizo coulis is a decadent start to the meal, followed by classics such as risotto with Boston lobster: for years a staple on the menu, it keeps regulars coming back. The perfect wine-and-dine spot for a Friday night out....
